design: Arabic coefficient challenger using the HL-3 hashed window features, with equal fit weight per source-class cell and per document within a cell. English coefficients and the eligibility, sentence mapping and display rules are unchanged. Fit one model with C=16 and no test-guided search.
train: Arabic AIRABIC and ARCD original development train groups plus the entire prior Ar-APT pair of original press corpora. Ar-APT changes from a prior test set to development data for this challenger. Assisted versions are omitted.
calibration: Only eligible human texts of the prior o-qn course-project corpus (never fit). Select the 99.5th percentile, higher order statistic, of maximum window margins plus 1e-8. Select once. English remains frozen.
new_arabic_test: KFUPM-JRCAI/arabic-text-detection commit 997da71482e77627bb0b777223628e9b23b8b7c1, Claude generation of abstracts from titles only, blob c0b4b35f01502fd96f4a88a72206bb8dfbb8c156. Remove a whole original/generated pair if either member is a normalized duplicate, within the reserved cohort or against previously available Arabic texts, or has >=20% exact seven-word containment in one previous source or prior selected member. Select at most 400 pairs in ascending SHA256(original) order. Never change the selection after scoring.
new_english_test: Frozen English control evaluated on new ArguGPT machine-ood.csv SHA1 git blob 057bff1d1bc2017f4c9be01b92c658a6a57d025d, commit cfbd00e75b63db44756375cfc1ee4278f8cd2bf1; hash-order deterministic maximum of 400 documents using the same overlap screen. Its paired human-ood release contains filenames only; use separately labeled existing human and learner studies.
group_separation: Development, calibration and new evaluation use separate publishers/corpora. Existing training groups are retained by article/source for humans and topic family for AI. Author identifiers are not supplied consistently; separation by individual across publications cannot be proved. Prior access to related KFUPM abstracts and ArguGPT test is handled by the overlap screen. New development-held-out study, not an independent examiner study.
secondary: Report earlier model's human and machine, assisted, back-translated and mixed cohorts separately, two-sided Wilson 95% for binomial document proportions and error in percentage points on word-controlled mixtures. For Arabic error review predeclare <96, 96-191, 192-383, 384+ word bands with ineligible counts reported separately.
decision: Require inclusive and numeric false-positive rates below 1% on newly reserved Arabic humans, at least 50% inclusive and numeric machine recall on newly reserved Arabic and English machine texts, without new abstentions. Also require previously unmet institutional criteria and independent committee data for production. Failing any research gate rejects promotion; no changes based on this holdout. Show all counts and cohort-specific uncertainty.
supplied_text_handling: Process original files privately; publish source hashes, selection hashes, aggregate results and model digest. Do not distribute student or paper text in the software.
